Row.Text: Open the Overlord's War Council to designate eligible Warrior-to-Mechanized Infantry units as Ascendants. Marathon cost is 120 Gold plus 60 per era after Ancient, with a 6-turn shared cooldown. Gold and cooldown scale by game speed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Capacity starts at 2 and rises by 1 in Medieval, Industrial and Atomic. Owning any Molting Chamber adds 1, up to 6 total. Ascendants keep their mutations when capacity falls.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Designation gives +10% defensive Combat Strength. From Classical, at 30 XP, permanently choose +15% attacking Combat Strength or +20% ranged defence. From Industrial, a specialised warrior with 100 XP becomes Apex automatically, gaining +10% Combat Strength, +5 HP when healing in friendly territory, and +2 Science in the current capital.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Existing XP counts. Mutations cost no XP and survive eligible upgrades. Loss or transfer ends that warrior's progression. Human players only.

From beneath the ancient earth emerged a civilisation unlike any the world had witnessed. Where lesser creatures relied upon overwhelming numbers, the Scorpion Dominion embraced a different truth: strength was not inherited, but earned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Through countless generations of struggle, its warriors developed hardened carapaces, devastating pincers and an unwavering instinct for survival. The greatest among them became Ascendants, living monuments to the Dominion's relentless pursuit of perfection.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Mighty Scorpion Overlord, your warriors await your command. Will you guide them through the trials of evolution? Will your chosen Ascendants endure the passing of ages and become the perfect predators of a new world?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Let empires rise with armies beyond counting. Let their banners darken the horizon.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Prove that strength shall always prevail over numbers.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Can you build a civilisation that will stand the test of time?
The Dominion raises elite line infantry through individual evolution. Train veterans, choose offensive or defensive mutations, and keep Apex warriors alive to support research in the capital.

Beneath the black sands, the Dominion carves its cities from volcanic glass. Its warriors measure their worth in molts endured and battles survived. Behind the walls of the Molting Chambers, keepers record the adaptations of each warrior as carefully as they record the names of the fallen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The scorpion faction of the 2009 browser game Arachnid Wars 1.5 inspired the Dominion. Survival of the Strongest and its Ascendant progression were designed for this Civilization V mod.
The Overlord is a colossal emperor scorpion whose patient rule rewards veterans and punishes threats to the Dominion.

The Overlord remembers every warrior who stood beside the throne when the Obsidian Nest was young. In council he listens in silence, weighing the cost of each engagement. A veteran who returns alive to fight again is worth more to him than a legion promised by some boastful envoy.
Swordsman replacement with 15 Combat Strength, 2 Movement, 75 base Production cost and a requirement of 1 Iron. Imperial Exoskeleton grants +15% defence against ranged attacks and survives upgrades.

Put Emperor Scorpions on the frontline against enemy ranged units. Designate a promising veteran and choose Obsidian Carapace to add another 20 percentage points of ranged defence. Any eligible Emperor Scorpion may instead specialise in attack.

The Emperor Scorpion is bred for the close fighting of the fortress galleries. Overlapping plates protect its joints when missiles strike from above. Its ordinary exoskeleton endures throughout its career, independently of Ascendant mutations.
Armory replacement that retains its training experience and adds +2 Science and +1 Production. Owning at least one increases the Dominion's Ascendant capacity by 1.

Build the first Molting Chamber to open an Ascendant slot. Further chambers train troops and improve city yields. If the final chamber is lost, existing Ascendants keep their mutations and new designations wait until enough capacity frees up.

Veterans train among amber-lit galleries while armour keepers study empty exoskeletons in the chambers below. The keepers maintain one empire-wide register of Ascendant warriors, regardless of how many chambers the Dominion builds.
+10% defensive Combat Strength. Stage I of Ascendant evolution. Occupies one Ascendant slot and survives eligible upgrades.
+15% Combat Strength when attacking. Permanent offensive Stage II mutation, exclusive with Obsidian Carapace.
+20% defence against ranged attacks. Permanent defensive Stage II mutation, exclusive with Crushing Pincers.
+10% Combat Strength and +5 additional HP when healing in friendly territory. While alive and owned by the human Dominion, contributes +2 Science in the current capital.
+15% defence against ranged attacks. Stays with the unit through upgrades and is independent of Ascendant evolution.
A warrior has shed its former shell and risen as an Ascendant of the Dominion.
Through battle and bloodshed, an Ascendant has developed a devastating new offensive adaptation.
An Ascendant's exoskeleton has hardened into an almost impenetrable shell.
After centuries of struggle, one of the Dominion's warriors has achieved Apex Evolution.
One of the Overlord's chosen warriors has fallen. Its legacy shall be preserved in the Hall of Fallen Ascendants.
You stand before the Overlord of the Dominion. Speak carefully. Strength is respected here; weakness is not.
Bring forth your armies. My Ascendants have grown weary of waiting.
You mistake patience for weakness. Your mistake shall be your final lesson.
Even the strongest carapace must eventually break. But somewhere beneath the earth, another shall rise.

Choose a warrior from the eligible infantry roster. Each designation starts the shared cooldown and immediately grants the First Molt.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Existing experience, health and movement carry through unchanged. Ascendants can evolve without spending experience.

Select an Ascendant to see its branch, progress and current promotions.
